nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Bayesian linear regression normative models with likelihood warping and B-spline basis functions (PCNtoolkit).
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: We employed the Bayesian linear regression function from the PCNtoolkit to create the normative models for each voxel... To ensure accurate modeling of nonlinear and non-Gaussian effects, we employed a B-spline basis function and likelihood warping
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: Fraza2023.pdf.md: Normative modeling with Bayesian linear regression

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Image-derived phenotypes (IDPs) from structural, functional, and diffusion MRI; voxel-wise Jacobian determinant of deformation fields (T1) for morphometric variation.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: Initially, we fit a normative model to each of the image-derived phenotypes (IDPs) derived from the structural, functional and diffusion measures from the UK Biobank... we used the Jacobian determinant of the deformation field which describes regional contractions or expansions necessary to align individuals to a common reference template

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Covariates included age, sex, and site (site as fixed effect).
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: using the covariates age, sex and site... Every normative model constructed factored in the covariates age and sex. To reduce site effects, we have added it as a fixed effect in the model.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.location: Fraza2023.pdf.md: Results; Normative modeling with Bayesian linear regression
